# REV 29 PORT — FINAL CONSOLIDATED EDIT LIST (40 content-keyed rows)

All edits are **merges** into the existing object unless marked DELETE. No key not listed is touched. Every hex/string below is verbatim from `docs/design/handoff/theme-patch-rev29.json`; the two exceptions are called out in-line.

## 1 · THE SULPHUR CASE — what the author will see change in game

The reported defect (小量死者硫磺 rendering tan/grey, 中量 on an orange off-family plate) is fixed by **three** edits, in two different files. Rev 29 *does* state the rung for every band — `theme-rungs-rev29.json → new_families."Dead Man's Sulphur 死者硫磺".rungs_by_stack = ["R2","R3","R4"]` — which the first-round plan missed.

| band | tier | today (block) | after port | edit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 大量 (`StackSize >= 3000`) | `Sulphur T0` | white/verdigris, `1 Yellow Diamond`, beam `Orange` (leaked from row `Tier 1`) | + `PlayEffect Yellow Temp` | A-3 |
| 中量 | `Sulphur T1` | **orange plate `255 165 0 240`**, FS40, `1 Yellow Diamond`, `Orange Temp` | white on verdigris `#00a070ff`, FS45, `2 Yellow Diamond`, `Yellow Temp` | A-4 |
| 少量 | `Sulphur T2` | **tan `170 158 130` on black `0 0 0 240`, no icon, no beam** | black on verdigris `#00a070ff`, FS43, `2 Yellow Diamond`, no beam | A-1 (row) |

A-1 is a **ROW** edit (`Curse of the Allflame / Tier 4`) because Sulphur T2 and Ducats T1 both sit on rung 4 and rev 29 gives them the *same* look — so the row can say it. A-4 must be **INLINE** because rung 2 has four claimants with three different rev-29 looks.

Also closed by this: `Sulphur T2` is one of the 59 `sound-without-icon` violations (`CustomAlertSound … AlertSound2` with no `MinimapIcon`).

## 6 · VERIFICATION PLAN

All commands from `g:/POE_filter_development/POE_filter_project`. Never write to `out/` names already in git status.

**Step 0 — baseline, before any edit** (three builds; the strictness gates differ, so one build proves nothing):

```
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode ruthless --strictness soft   --out out/rev29-before-soft.filter   --trace out/rev29-before-soft.trace.json
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode ruthless --strictness regular --out out/rev29-before-reg.filter
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode standard --strictness regular --out out/rev29-before-std.filter
git stash list && git status --porcelain filter_generation/data
```

**Step 1 — apply the edits file by file** (§2.1 → §2.8), committing per file so a bad row can be reverted alone.

**Step 2 — rebuild the same three:**

```
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode ruthless --strictness soft   --out out/rev29-after-soft.filter   --trace out/rev29-after-soft.trace.json
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode ruthless --strictness regular --out out/rev29-after-reg.filter
node filter_generation/generate.mjs --mode standard --strictness regular --out out/rev29-after-std.filter
```

**Step 3 — the whole-file diff must contain ONLY the expected channels.** Expected: `+PlayEffect`, `+MinimapIcon`, and — for A-1/A-4/H-1/H-2/H-3 only — `SetTextColor`/`SetBackgroundColor`/`SetFontSize`. Any other changed line is a defect.

```
diff -u out/rev29-before-soft.filter out/rev29-after-soft.filter > out/rev29.diff
grep -E '^[+-]' out/rev29.diff | grep -vE '^(\+\+\+|---)' | sed -E 's/^([+-])\s*/\1 /' | awk '{print $1, $2}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
```

Assert, line by line:
- `- PlayEffect` count = 6 (Fossils T0/T1 Orange, Fossils T3 Yellow Temp, Runegrafts 纹身 Orange Temp, Base Jewels Normal + Rare Blue Temp) — **no other removals**
- `- MinimapIcon` count = 1 (Oils T1, `1 Yellow Diamond` → `2 Yellow Diamond`) — a second removal means an icon was stripped
- **zero** `- CustomAlertSound` / `- PlayAlertSound` lines — the patch never models sound
- **zero** `- SetBorderColor` lines — `_border_convention`

| category | command |
|---|---|

**Step 5 — invariant sweeps on the *after* build:**

```
python - <<'PY'
import re
txt=open('out/rev29-after-soft.filter',encoding='utf8').read()
blocks=re.split(r'\n(?=#==\[)',txt)
snd=[b for b in blocks if re.search(r'(Custom|Play)AlertSound',b) and 'MinimapIcon' not in b]
ico=[b for b in blocks if 'MinimapIcon' in b and not re.search(r'(Custom|Play)AlertSound',b)]
beam=[b for b in blocks if 'PlayEffect' in b and 'MinimapIcon' not in b]
print('sound-no-icon',len(snd),'icon-no-sound',len(ico),'beam-no-icon',len(beam))
PY
```
Expected movement vs the same script on `rev29-before-soft.filter`: **sound-no-icon must fall** (Sulphur T2, Fossils T3, Voyage Charts, Stygian T3, Heist Contract/Blueprint T1, Maps 黄图/白图); **icon-no-sound rises by ~6** (Class Nets) + the prized rows — that rise is R-3, expected and reported, not a regression. **beam-no-icon must not rise.**
